project_title: Aplikasi Rekap Lembur Karyawan (Overtime Management System)
archetype: Architectural / Precision Utility (Performance Pro & Corporate Slate)
app_type: hybrid_fullstack (Data-Heavy Internal HR/Operations Tool with Mobile & Desktop Responsive Views)
design_principles: Precision Over Clutter: High density data presentation with clear visual hierarchy, subtle 1px slate borders, and explicit status badges.

Role-Based Clarity: Clear structural distinction between Admin controls (Add/Edit Employee, Add Overtime Entry, Master Edit, Full Export) and Employee controls (Self-Edit Start/End Time, Location, Note, Photo Upload).

Mobile-First Ergonomics: Touch-friendly touch targets (min 44px) for mobile phone access, bottom drawer/modal for fast employee field updates, and horizontal scrollable responsive tables with sticky employee name columns.
Indonesian Business Nuance: Native Indonesian terms ('Rekap Lembur', 'Jam Mulai', 'Jam Akhir', 'Total Lembur', 'Lokasi/Hari', 'Upload Foto Kondisi', 'Tambah Karyawan', 'Unduh Excel/CSV').

theme.note: Header and navigation components must use solid or high-opacity backdrop surfaces (bg-slate-900/95 dark or bg-white/95 light with backdrop-blur-md). NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds for headers or dropdowns.

authentication.description: Role selection (Admin / Karyawan) with login modal or page using email and password.

overtime_recap_table.auto_calculation_rule: Calculate difference between Jam Mulai (e.g., 17:00) and Jam Akhir (e.g., 21:30). Display exact formatted string, e.g., '4 Jam 30 Menit' or '4.5 Jam'. Handle midnight edge cases gracefully.

admin: Tambah / Edit / Hapus Master Karyawan (Sheet Karyawan)
Input Data Rekap Lembur Baru untuk Karyawan manapun
Filter per rentang tanggal & per karyawan
employee: Lihat daftar lembur milik sendiri (atau view-only untuk rekan)
Edit khusus jam mulai, jam akhir, lokasi hari, keterangan lembur, dan upload foto milik sendiri
Total lembur terhitung otomatis saat jam diubah

photo_upload_feature.description: Allow image file upload (JPG/PNG/WEBP) or camera capture preview with modal light-box viewer.

export_feature.action: Download sheet rekap lembur terfilter berdasarkan tanggal

key_components.name: HeaderNav
key_components.purpose: Logo Perusahaan, Role Indicator, User Avatar, Quick Switch Role (for demo), Dark Mode Toggle, and Logout button.

key_components.name: OvertimeStatsCards
key_components.purpose: Summary stats (Total Jam Lembur Bulan Ini, Jumlah Karyawan Lembur, Rekap Hari Ini, Status Foto Verified).

key_components.name: OvertimeFilterBar
key_components.purpose: Filter tanggal (Single Date / Range), Filter Karyawan, Search Keterangan, and Export Buttons.

key_components.name: OvertimeTable
key_components.purpose: Responsive desktop table with inline calculate badge, photo preview trigger, and edit button.

key_components.name: OvertimeMobileList
key_components.purpose: Card-based view optimized for smartphones (HP view) with full tap targets and quick edit modal trigger.

key_components.name: EmployeeManagementModal
key_components.purpose: Sheet / Modal for Admin to manage employee master data (NIP, Nama, Jabatan, Email, Password, Status Aktif).

key_components.name: OvertimeEditModal
key_components.purpose: Modal dialog for Employee / Admin to update Jam Mulai, Jam Akhir, Lokasi, Keterangan, and Upload Foto.

key_components.name: PhotoPreviewModal
key_components.purpose: Full-size photo lightbox to inspect uploaded proof photo of overtime.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text throughout the application is in clear, natural Bahasa Indonesia.
Implement accurate automatic calculation of total overtime hours and minutes when Jam Mulai or Jam Akhir changes.
Support file uploads with live thumbnail image preview and lightbox expansion.
Build both desktop table view and a mobile-optimized card layout for HP users.
Ensure Admin can manage employee master list ('Sheet Edit Karyawan') and edit any field, while Employee can edit their designated fields.
Use proper data-testid attributes on all key interactive elements as mapped above.
Use solid/glass-backed headers (backdrop-blur-md with semi-opaque background) to avoid unreadable text overlay.
